product.description: Frank şi April Wheeler s-au considerat intotdeauna un cuplu deosebit, dar, după ce au adus pe lume doi copii, au ajuns să se impace cu o existenţă convenţională intr-o suburbie din Connecticut. Tacirc;njind după o viaţă mai puţin mărginită, April il convinge pe Frank să se mute cu familia la Paris, dar, incet-incet, planurile şi, odată cu ele, căsnicia celor doi iau o turnură tragică. Romanul Revolutionary Road a fost ecranizat de regizorul Sam Mendes intr-un film cu Leonardo DiCaprio şi Kate Winslet in rolurile principale. Pelicula a fost nominalizată la premiile Oscar, Globul de Aur şi BAFTA. Un studiu remarcabil pe o temă tipic americană, aceea a individului devenit bdquo;prizonier al propriei vieţildquo;, o realizare cu adevărat impresionantă. Revolutionary Road spune cu sensibilitate, cu vigoare şi cu o conştiinţă acută a complexităţii şi ambiguităţii umanului o poveste mişcătoare şi fascinantă. The Atlantic Monthly

# Revolutionary Road by Litera ## Explore a Profound Study of Modern Relationships Dive into *Revolutionary Road*, a deeply moving and complex novel that explores the fragile nature of marriage and the yearning for an unrestrained existence. From the celebrated brand **Litera**, this book offers readers a powerful narrative experience, drawing comparisons to its acclaimed film adaptation starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet. *Revolutionary Road* tells the story of Frank and April Wheelerâa couple who initially considered themselves extraordinary. However, after welcoming two children into their lives in a typical Connecticut suburb, they find themselves grappling with the constraints of conventional life. Yearning for something less confined, April convinces Frank to move the family to Paris. Yet, as their dreams take root abroad, the plansâand consequently, the marriage itselfâbegin a tragic turn. ### A Masterpiece of Literary Depth The novel is recognized as more than just a romance; it is a remarkable study of a deeply American theme: the individual becoming a prisoner within their own life. *Revolutionary Road* is a moving and fascinating story that handles human complexity and ambiguity with keen sensitivity and vigor. As noted by publications like *The Atlantic Monthly*, the book captures the intricate emotional landscape of modern partnership. The narrative's depth was evident on screen, where Sam Mendes directed a film adaptation, earning multiple nominations including those for the Academy Awards (Oscar), Golden Globe, and BAFTA. For readers who appreciate literary fiction with cinematic quality, this title is an essential read. --- ### Product Details * **Title:** Revolutionary Road * **Brand:** Litera * **Category:** Books * **Price:** $39.99 [Purchase Revolutionary Road today and begin your journey into literary depth by clicking here!](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=f93c9709e&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9) ### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **What is *Revolutionary Road* about?** The novel follows Frank and April Wheeler as they navigate the difficulties of maintaining a passionate life while grappling with the constraints placed upon them by conventional suburban married life, eventually leading them to Paris. **Is this book related to the movie adaptation?** Yes, the story was adapted into a film directed by Sam Mendes and starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet. The novel provides the rich literary source material for the acclaimed work. **What themes does the book explore?** Key themes include the struggle between individual freedom and commitment, the complexities of marriage, and the search for authentic selfhood against societal expectations.
